name: Azure Quick Review: read-only Azure assessment
purpose: Read Azure resource inventory, resiliency recommendations, Advisor findings, Defender plan status, and diagnostics configuration for one subscription and an optional resource group. Display structured findings and generate a report for human and LLM review; no remediation is performed.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.label: Microsoft Entra tenant ID
parameters.help: Tenant ID GUID for the AzureServicePrincipal application. Public Azure only.

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.label: Azure subscription ID
parameters.help: One subscription ID GUID. Grant the application Reader at this subscription; no write role is needed.

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.label: Resource group (optional)
parameters.help: Leave blank for the subscription, or enter one resource-group name to narrow the read-only scan.

parameters.name: AzqrPath
parameters.label: Trusted azqr.exe version 4.2.0 path
parameters.help: Full path to the official version 4.2.0 Windows binary. The optional Install-Azqr.ps1 local setup downloads and checksum-verifies the reviewed binary; see directions.txt.
